exact: PCD in response to reactive oxygen species
reactive oxygen species-mediated programmed cell death
broad: PCD in response to oxidative stress
programmed cell death in response to oxidative stress

definition: Cell death resulting from activation of endogenous cellular processes and occurring as a result of a reactive oxygen species stimulus. Reactive oxygen species include singlet oxygen, superoxide, and oxygen free radicals.
label: programmed cell death in response to reactive oxygen species
